title: Argus warden result (v1)
description: What the warden returns and what the gateway forwards VERBATIM. The gateway validates only the envelope; it must never re-serialise this object.

req.description: Echoes the command's req. The gateway rejects a mismatch.

subject.description: Echoes the command's subject. The gateway rejects a mismatch.

duplicate.description: This req was already answered; the original answer is replayed.

error.description: Safe category. Present only when ok is false. Never an upstream body, URL, credential or trace.

state.description: ALWAYS PRESENT, including the empty string. Must not be omitempty.

clients.description: ALWAYS PRESENT, including zero. omitempty here previously deleted clients:0 and the ship read it as malformed.

gen.description: ALWAYS PRESENT, including zero. Room incarnation; a reused room key gets a new gen.

deadline.description: ALWAYS PRESENT, including zero. Lease expiry, Unix seconds UTC.

group.description: Managed group id on the SFU.

token.description: SECRET. Galene join credential, minted per participant. Never logged.

sfu.description: Websocket URL the browser connects to.

participant.description: Who this access was minted FOR.

ice.description: Browser-ready RTCIceServer entries. SECRET on TURN entries.

access_expires.description: Unix seconds. Credentials stop being usable for NEW allocations.

renew_after.description: Unix seconds. When the caller should ask for fresh credentials.
